chunks: Aban asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: “Did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله have a known pattern of tawaf?” So he said:

The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله used to perform tawaf by night and day in ten asbūʿ: three at the beginning of the night, three at the end of the night, two when morning came, and two after noon; and in between that was his rest.

key_terms.آخِرَ اللَّيْلِ: the last portion of the night
key_terms.أَسَابِيعَ: sets of seven circuits of tawaf
key_terms.أَوَّلَ اللَّيْلِ: the beginning portion of the night

ai.seo_question: What was the Messenger of Allah’s صلى الله عليه وآله regular pattern of tawaf?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a regular pattern in the tawaf of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله. It shows the constancy of his worship and preserves a practical aspect of his sunnah in relation to tawaf.
